gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions table (Gross claims at 1 Jan 2015 = GBP 102,816k). The report explicitly discloses a net (after reinsurance) prior year strengthening of GBP 4.4m; however an explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities column) labeled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' was not found in a clearly labelled single-line note. The Technical Provisions reconciliation shows total gross movement for the year (Movement per technical account = GBP 48,148k) which includes current year activity and is therefore not appropriate for the prior-year development figure per the instructions. A claims development table is present but was ambiguous to reliably derive the aggregate GROSS prior-year development within the time available. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is null and the direction is inferred from the reported net movement (GBP 4.4m strengthening). Prior-year event information (cargo losses 2014, professional liability immaturity) is derived from narrative. Confidence levels reflect availability of explicit gross figures (high for opening reserves, lower for PYD and LOB-specific impacts).
